main.description: Public metadata for one of a creator's paid subscription tiers — name/price/description only, so prospective subscribers can see what's on offer. The authoritative billing record (Prisma SubscriptionTier, see prompts/full.md Phase 5) is never mirrored here beyond these safe fields. MUST NOT ever contain: customer payment IDs, billing history, subscriber lists, legal names, tax information, or payout information.

monthlyPrice.description: Integer minor units (e.g. cents), matching the private SubscriptionTier.priceCents convention — never a decimal major-unit amount.
